name: io.github.sparedotemail/spare-email-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for spare.email mailboxes: list mail, read messages, wait for OTP codes.
title: Spare Email MCP

environmentVariables.name: SPARE_EMAIL_JWT
environmentVariables.description: Address JWT of the spare.email (or self-hosted cloudflare_temp_email) mailbox to access

environmentVariables.name: SPARE_EMAIL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the deployment (default: https://spare.email; set for self-hosted instances)

environmentVariables.name: SPARE_EMAIL_SITE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Global x-custom-auth access password, if the deployment enforces one
